method.general: Opposing .1 luminance peak/valley transitions, darker<.8, non-overlapping transition pairs.
method.red: Linear-sRGB R/(R+G+B)>=.8 and CIE1976 UCS distance>.2; two axis extrema union conservatively screens opposing color transitions.
method.spatial: Exact max-area integral over every341x256 window at1024x768. >3 per-pixel flashes and conservative large-closing-frame count in inclusive1second windows.
limitations: 60Hz content-clock SDR/sRGB capture, not HDR or hardware artifacts.
Canvas only; CSS HUD/layout assessed separately.
Hysteresis/axis-union screening is reproducible, not accredited PEAT/Harding certification.
Closing-frame aggregate can overcount a spatially staggered flash; flagged cases require frame/region review.
Synthetic overlap stress is deliberately conservative and not physical progression.
